transcript.answer: Before 2026-09-23, Gemini agent pods had no MCP tools for two stacked reasons. First, gemini-cli has no MCP flag and only reads MCP servers from its settings files. The subsystem rendered a recipe's `mcp_servers` only for Claude, so Gemini pods got no Lore MCP at all (lore #2133). Subsystem v0.11.2 tried to fix this by writing the servers to a system-scope settings file, `/agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json`, and pointing `GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH` at it. gemini-cli refused that file with "Security Warning: Skipping system settings file… Parent directory is not owned by root (uid 0). Current uid: 1000", because the pod runs as uid 1000 and the directory isn't root-owned. The CLI therefore started with "(0 tools)" and made no MCP calls. Subsystem v0.11.3 (#246) fixed this by merging the servers into the user settings file `/agent/.gemini/settings.json`. This was confirmed working on 2026-09-23.
sources: CLAUDE.md (Task Pipeline: Live agent MCP access)

judgements.reason: The answer states that v0.11.2 wrote MCP servers to a system-scope settings file that gemini-cli refused due to the uid-1000 non-root-owned directory, and that v0.11.3 moved them to /agent/.gemini/settings.json, matching the gold answer.
